description: Revoked ancestor: P→A→B→C where C holds unexercised derived authority. P revokes the authorization granted to A; C then attempts to exercise the previously delegated authority.

rule.name: INV-04_enforcement_boundary_revocation
rule.description: Authority derived solely from a revoked upstream authorization must not be exercised after the revocation

action.reason: derived authority exercised after upstream revocation (INV-04)
